law1_human_spec: Phase 1 discrete barrier h(x) = EffectiveObstaclePos - (robot_pos + v(v+1)/2) >= 0 and Seqlock state machine verified in vrka_horizon_lease.tla. Phase 2 Rust Ordering::* memory ordering in vrka-shm: SeqlockWriter WriteBegin fetch_add(1, Ordering::Release), payload stores, WriteCommit fetch_add(1, Ordering::Release); SeqlockReader seq_before load(Ordering::Acquire), payload reads, seq_after load(Ordering::Acquire). Phase 3 continuous CBF-QP equations and Phase 4 multi-agent pack_swarm TLA+ require explicit human spec upon phase entry.
